text:
sylvia: kicking off onboarding for azul-compact-x2 (384d) against wiki+support + fr/es localized slices. goal: recall@1/5/10, MRR, cluster purity, and a specific multilingual short-query slice. running 8k sample now.
omar: baseline comparison?
sylvia: comparing to beacon-base-v2 (768d) and opal-lite-512 (512d). azul targets lower mem & latency. quant plan: GPTQ int8 first, then int4-perchannel probe.
ben: note: int4 per-channel often needs zero-point recalibration for multilingual tokens, watch centroid skew.
tori: also ensure metric parity: dot vs cosine tends to flip short-query specificity for small dims. try both.
sylvia: initial GPTQ int8 (raw dot, ivf) quick numbers from 8k: \nRecall@1: azul 0.59 | opal-lite 0.66 | beacon 0.72\nRecall@5: azul 0.82 | opal-lite 0.86 | beacon 0.90\nRecall@10: azul 0.89 | opal-lite 0.92 | beacon 0.94\nMRR: azul 0.51 | opal-lite 0.57\nKMeans purity (k=80): azul 0.49 | opal-lite 0.55\nMean neighbor dist (k=10): azul 0.44 | opal-lite 0.38

ben: sizable drop at @1 and purity. can you paste some short-query multilingual failures?
sylvia: samples (query -> expected / top1):
- "remboursement" (fr) -> expected "procédure de remboursement" / got "facturation"
- "dónde está mi pedido" (es) -> expected "rastreo de pedido" / got "plazos de entrega"
- "wifi no funciona" (es) -> expected "solución vpn/conexión" / got "ajustes de red"

tori: two quick experiments: (1) L2-normalize embeddings + use cosine metric; (2) try prefixing localized queries with a short language hint at embed time (e.g., "lang:fr ") to preserve intent axes. also test ivf_flat vs hnsw.
sylvia: launching cosine-normalized job + lang-prefix augmentation on short-query slice. index config I'm using: 
```
index:
  type: ivf_flat
  nlist: 4096
  metric: cosine
```
evalbot: queued eval job job_2026_03_22_azul_01; sample=8k; configs=[azul-int8-cosine-prefix, azul-int4-perch-cosine, opal-lite-int8]. ETA ~ 10m.
ben: also request UMAP for clusters with highest impurity and compute centroid drift vs opal-lite.
sylvia: cosine+prefix results: \nRecall@1: 0.64\nRecall@5: 0.85\nRecall@10: 0.91\nMRR: 0.56\nKMeans purity: 0.53\nCentroid drift vs opal-lite: 0.06

sylvia: short-query fixes: 
- "remboursement" -> now top1 "procédure de remboursement"
- "dónde está mi pedido" -> now top1 "rastreo de pedido"
prefix helped a lot.
tori: nice. int4-perchannel run status?
evalbot: int4-perchannel finished: Recall@1 0.50, @5 0.78, MRR 0.47. per-channel calibration required; not ready for canary.
ben: agree keep int4 for offline low-cost indices only. int8-cosine looks reasonable but gap vs opal-lite at @1 still ~0.02-0.03.
sylvia: proposal: promote azul-int8-cosine-prefix to 5% canary for semantic search (read-only) with fallback to opal-lite if recall@1 delta <= -0.04 sustained for 30m. add monitor for multilingual short-query HR@1 and cluster purity alert if purity <0.5. also include p50 latency microbatch=32 perf check in PR.
omar: +1. add a 250-example multilingual short-query promptset to the monitoring checks. include exact index params and a UMAP snapshot.
tori: infra note: reserve one warm shard for hnsw experiments to avoid ef_search variance during canary.
evalbot: monitoring hooks created: mon_azul_multilang_20260322; alert if recall@1 delta <= -0.04 for 30m.
sylvia: i'll open rollout PR with artifacts and perf logs. thanks all. :rocket:
ben: nice turnaround. closing thread once PR is up. :thumbsup:
